pages.text: The Wireless Fluid Grid is a portable version of the regular Fluid Grid that allows you to access your fluid storage network from anywhere within range of a Wireless Transmitter.

To use the Wireless Fluid Grid:$(li)Right-click while holding it to open the interface$(li)Insert a Network Card to connect to a wireless network$(li)Use it within range of a configured Wireless Transmitter$(li)Access and manage your fluids just like a regular Fluid Grid

The Wireless Fluid Grid supports all the same features as a regular Fluid Grid, including:$(li)Viewing and managing fluids$(li)Searching and filtering$(li)Sorting and grouping$(li)Using Grid Filters$(li)Viewing fluid amounts and tanks
